svg.title: Code, artifacts, and configuration delivery
svg.desc: Gitea Actions executes host jobs. Argo CD reads the lab repository on GitHub and applies selected cluster resources.

g.text: Gitea Actions executes host jobs. Argo CD reads the lab repository on GitHub and applies selected cluster resources.
Host workflows run as gitea-runner with Docker access.
Docker state: 100 GiB ext4 disk at /var/lib/docker.
Jobs can leave state behind; the VM is the isolation
Trivy gets vulnerability databases from upstream OCI.
Valkey and scanner databases stay on the Harbor VM.
Ansible: service guests, kubeadm, containerd, Cilium / Hubble workloads, node firewalls, HAProxy.
Helm: Argo CD release, including its HTTPS route; kubectl: bootstrap resources and Argo Applications.
Argo Applications: the selected resources above, after deliberate adoption through manual sync.
Vault CLI: authentication roles, ACL policies, and KV data. ESO: generated Kubernetes Secret values.
Technitium UI: private DNS records and DHCP. These responsibilities have separate update workflows.
